prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a modern luxury car’s center console, focusing on the sleek automatic gear shifter. The gear lever is prominently featured in the foreground, crafted from polished metal and glossy black materials, reflecting ambient light with a high-end, futuristic finish. Surrounding the shifter are touch-sensitive buttons and controls, all illuminated with soft white and blue LED backlighting, enhancing the sophisticated, high-tech atmosphere. The background is subtly blurred, drawing attention to the crisp lines and premium textures of the console. The overall color palette is cool and monochromatic, dominated by deep blues, silvers, and blacks, creating a refined, almost sci-fi mood. The lighting is low and moody, with gentle highlights accentuating the contours and surfaces, evoking a sense of luxury, precision, and advanced automotive design. The composition is tight and intimate, shot from a slightly elevated angle to emphasize the ergonomics and craftsmanship of the interior.
